# SIGINTENT — Antonio Elena — full text

> Independent technology advisory: fractional CTO, architecture review, AI strategy, and cloud and distributed-systems guidance. This file carries the complete text of every essay so a model can read the whole corpus in one request. The short index is at {{ '/llms.txt' | absolute_url }}.

Author: Antonio Elena — CTO at BEAI Energy, previously Global Head of Architecture & Technology at SGS, where he ran the architecture function across 800+ projects reporting to the Group CIO. Two decades across enterprise, consulting and startups. Past work includes KPMG, Aviva, Maersk, Experian, Equifax, Siemens and PwC.
